_README: Hand-written layer of the per-test data map (QA lead, 2026-10-05). Read by tools/build_data_map.py together with each seeded record's 'serves' note and the search words in entity-config / retest-plan / held-terms, and turned into data/test-data.json. A key may list several cases separated by commas. Each entry says what the test needs: 'needs' (records '<plan>:<key>' or steps '<plan>:#<step>'), 'words' (a search word - every seeded record holding it), 'bundles' (named sets below), and, where nothing of ours is needed, 'none' / 'baseline' / 'own' with the reason. 'baseline' = the shop's standard starting records, which a reset of the branch restores (measured 2026-10-05: they carry creation dates on or before the last reset, 2026-09-28 14:19).

every-kind._why: one findable record of every kind: the suite's 'live' sample values (a serial number, part number, part sale, purchase order, invoice) are taken from what the branch holds, and these guarantee each kind is not empty

broad._why: the broad search word ('transport' first) must light up several kinds of record

v1reg._why: the V1-regression family (ZZAUTOTEST Bridgeport Hauling, its contact Marlene, the 2019 Freightliner Cascadia, Kestrel Parts Supply, ZZT-88-4412 and the part sale)

areas._why: one record per access area, for the permission checks (the toggle plan)
